intent: Eight individual character tasks preserve reported actions, communication modes, kind truth, reuse, relative independence and an unmet need.
picturePurpose: An original paired caps/game picture supports direct new-use choices. The authored context establishes discarded-cap provenance; pictures do not diagnose personality, intelligence or feelings. A coded direction selector represents more independent without numerical amounts or a promise of never needing help.

workshop.title: 找新用途，再核对人物记录
workshop.instruction: 点出旧物新用途，记录独立性的变化；别用性格标签代替行动证据。

items.label: shy：害羞的学生怎样分享想法？
items.prompt: 害羞的学生怎样分享想法？
items.material: The shy pupil shared an idea in writing.
items.after: pupil shared an idea in writing.
items.reason: shy表示害羞的。in writing是用文字；shared an idea说明想法确实分享出来了。不要由害羞推断学生没有表达，也不要把书面表达改成演讲。

wordDecision.prompt: 害羞的学生怎样分享想法？

recordSelection.title: 分享过，用的是文字
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 用文字分享想法
rows.text: The pupil shared an idea in writing.

rows.label: 通过演讲分享
rows.text: The pupil shared the idea in a speech.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选用文字分享；不要换方式或删掉行动。

options.text: The pupil delivered the idea in a speech.
options.reason: 文字被换成了演讲。

options.text: The pupil did not share any idea.
options.reason: shy不等于没有分享；shared已经报告行动。

options.text: The pupil shared an idea in writing.
options.reason: in writing明确说明用文字分享。

items.label: outgoing：outgoing在这里描述什么？
items.material: Our outgoing classmate enjoys meeting new people.
items.reason: outgoing在这里是形容词，表示外向、爱交往。enjoys meeting new people给出具体喜好，不是报告现在正在出门，也不能据此断定他在任何场合都不害羞。
items.hint: 描述性格，不是正在出门。

recordSelection.title: 喜欢结识新人
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 喜欢结识新人
rows.text: The classmate enjoys meeting new people.

rows.label: 此刻正在出门
rows.text: The classmate is going outside now.

rows.label: 回避结识新人
rows.text: The classmate avoids meeting new people.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选喜欢结识新人；不补正在出门，也不反转喜好。

options.text: The classmate is sociable and enjoys meeting new people.
options.reason: outgoing描述性格，后半句说明喜欢结识新人。

options.text: The classmate is going outside at this moment.
options.reason: outgoing不是is going out，句中也没有at this moment。

options.text: The classmate avoids meeting new people.
options.reason: enjoys被反转成avoids。

items.label: creative：点出把旧瓶盖用进游戏的方案。
items.prompt: 点出把旧瓶盖用进游戏的方案。
items.material: A creative solution turned the waste into a game.
items.after: solution turned the waste into a game.
items.reason: creative表示有创造力的、有创意的；solution是解决办法。turn A into B表示把A变成B。本题设定这些是准备丢弃的旧瓶盖，右图把它们用作棋子。图片呈现新用途，旧物来源由情境给出；不能由作品给某个人的智力或性格下结论。
items.hint: 先读情境，再找旧物的新用途。

wordDecision.prompt: 情境：这些旧瓶盖原本准备丢弃。点出把瓶盖用进游戏的方案。

art.alt: 左边是散放的彩色瓶盖，右边是把瓶盖用作棋子的游戏板；旧物来源由题目情境说明。

evidence.caption: A只展示散放瓶盖，没有呈现游戏中的新用途。
B把瓶盖用作棋子。它们原来准备丢弃，是题目给出的情境，不是看图能证明的来源。

options.text: The caps are still loose and have no new game use shown.
options.reason: 左图只放着瓶盖，没有呈现本题要找的新用途。

options.text: Discarded caps have been reused as game pieces.
options.reason: 右图把瓶盖用作棋子；旧瓶盖的来源由本题情境给出。

items.label: curious：孩子问的是锁的什么？
items.material: The curious child asked how the lock worked.
items.after: child asked how the lock worked.
items.reason: curious表示好奇的，常用be curious about。how the lock worked是问锁怎样工作，不是问为什么坏了；asked没有报告修理行动。间接问句用陈述语序the lock worked。

recordSelection.title: 询问锁怎样工作
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 问锁怎样工作
rows.text: The child asked how the lock worked.

rows.label: 问锁为何坏了
rows.text: The child asked why the lock was broken.

rows.label: 已经成功修好
rows.text: The child repaired the lock successfully.

recordSelection.hint: 别把工作原理换成损坏原因。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选问锁怎样工作；不能补锁坏了或已修好。

options.text: The child asked why the lock was broken.
options.reason: how it worked被换成why it was broken。

options.text: The child repaired the lock successfully.
options.reason: asked只报告提问，不等于已经修好。

options.text: The child asked how the lock worked.
options.reason: how问工作原理或方式。

items.label: modest：获奖后，他的态度怎样？
items.material: He remained modest about winning the prize.
items.reason: modest在这里表示谦虚的，remained modest是仍保持谦虚。about winning the prize限定谈论获奖时的态度，不是没获奖，也没有说奖项很小。modest在其他语境中可表示规模或数量不大。

recordSelection.title: 获奖后仍保持谦虚
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 获奖后仍谦虚
rows.text: He remained modest about winning the prize.

rows.label: 从来没有获奖
rows.text: He had never won a prize.

rows.label: 不断炫耀奖项
rows.text: He kept boasting about the prize.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选获奖后仍谦虚；不能删掉获奖或反转态度。

options.text: He continued to be modest about his prize.
options.reason: remained表示继续保持，winning the prize说明已获奖。

options.text: He had not won any prize.
options.reason: 把winning the prize抹掉了。

options.text: He kept boasting about the prize.
options.reason: modest被反转成炫耀。

items.label: loyal：忠诚的朋友怎样说实话？
items.prompt: 忠诚的朋友怎样说实话？
items.material: A loyal friend tells you the truth kindly.
items.after: friend tells you the truth kindly.
items.reason: loyal表示忠诚的，常用be loyal to。这里把忠诚的做法写成友善地说实话；truth限定内容，kindly限定方式。不能把友善说成撒谎，也不能把说实话当作伤人表达的理由。
items.hint: 内容是真话，方式是友善。

wordDecision.prompt: 忠诚的朋友怎样说实话？

recordSelection.title: 友善地说实话
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 友善地说实话
rows.text: The friend tells the truth kindly.

rows.label: 刻薄地说实话
rows.text: The friend tells the truth cruelly.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选友善地说实话；别只保留内容或只保留方式。

options.text: The friend lies kindly to protect you.
options.reason: truth被换成lies。

options.text: The friend tells the truth in a kind way.
options.reason: truth和kindly两条都要保留。

options.text: The friend tells the truth in a cruel way.
options.reason: kindly被换成cruelly。

items.label: independent：学会做饭后，独立性怎样变化？
items.prompt: 学会做饭后，独立性怎样变化？
items.material: Learning to cook made me more independent.
items.before: Learning to cook made me more
items.reason: independent是形容词，more independent表示更加独立，只有变化方向，没有给出测量值。Learning to cook是让独立性增强的经历；不是任何事情都永远不需要帮助，也没有比较我和另一个人。
items.hint: more是更，不是完全；不比较两个人。

wordDecision.prompt: 学会做饭后，独立性怎样变化？

reportedChange.title: 记录独立性的变化
reportedChange.label: 独立性
reportedChange.event: Learning to cook made me more independent.
reportedChange.hint: 只按原句记变化方向；没有测量数值，也不表示凡事都不用帮助。
reportedChange.wrong: more independent支持独立性增强，不是完全不变或减弱；也不等于永远不需要帮助。

options.text: My independence did not change at all.
options.reason: more被抹掉，变成没有变化。

options.text: I would never need help with anything again.
options.reason: more independent不能扩大成任何事都永远不用帮助。

options.text: I became more independent after learning to cook.
options.reason: more表示更，不是完全不需要帮助。

items.label: dependable：备用钥匙的保管人已经找到了吗？
items.prompt: 备用钥匙的保管人已经找到了吗？
items.material: We need a dependable person to hold the spare key.
items.after: person to hold the spare key.
items.reason: dependable表示可靠、值得信赖的。need说明需要这样的人，to hold the spare key说明保管备用钥匙的用途；没有报告已经找到人，也没有说钥匙归这个人所有。
items.hint: need是需要；保管不等于拥有。

wordDecision.prompt: 备用钥匙的保管人已经找到了吗？

recordSelection.title: 需要可靠的人保管备用钥匙
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 需要可靠的人
rows.text: A reliable person is needed to hold the spare key.

rows.label: 已经找到人选
rows.text: A reliable person has already been found.

rows.label: 拥有楼内所有钥匙
rows.text: The person owns every key in the building.

recordSelection.hint: 需求不是已找到；保管不是拥有。
recordSelection.wrong: 只选需要可靠的人；不能补已找到或所有钥匙的所有权。

options.text: A reliable person is needed to hold the spare key.
options.reason: need说明需求，不表示已经选定。

options.text: A reliable person has already been found.
options.reason: 把需求补成已经找到。

options.text: The person owns every key in the building.
options.reason: hold不等于拥有，spare key也不是every key。

transfer.stem: Which notes keep the sharing method, the new use and the unfinished need?
transfer.passage:
Our club project
A shy pupil shared her idea in writing. Our outgoing classmate enjoyed meeting the new club members. We had some old bottle caps that were going to be thrown away. A creative idea gave them a new use as game pieces.
A curious child asked how the game worked. Mei won a prize for the design but remained modest. Her loyal friend told her the truth kindly when a rule was unclear.
Learning to prepare a simple meal made me more independent. We still need a dependable person to hold the spare key; nobody has been chosen yet.

options.text: An idea was shared in writing; old caps gained a game use; a key holder is still needed.
No idea was shared; old caps gained a game use; a key holder is still needed.
An idea was shared in writing; old caps stayed unused; a key holder is still needed.
An idea was shared in writing; old caps gained a game use; the key holder has already been chosen.

answer.display: An idea was shared in writing; old caps gained a game use; a key holder is still needed.

explanation.strategy: 依次核对分享方式、旧物新用途和保管人是否已选定。

steps.text: 学生用文字分享了想法；旧瓶盖变成棋子，有了新用途。
steps.reason: shared her idea in writing支持书面分享；new use as game pieces支持旧物再利用。

steps.text: 保管备用钥匙的人仍没选好，不能把需求写成已经完成。
steps.reason: still need和nobody has been chosen yet一起限定事情还未完成。

distractors.reason: shy被错误扩大成没有分享，忽略shared her idea。
忽略new use as game pieces，把再利用改成闲置。
把still need和nobody has been chosen yet反转成已经选定。

explanation.pitfall: 把性格替代实际行动，把旧物来源当成用途不变，把需求当成已经完成。

visual.title: 行动、用途、需求
visual.caption: 读实际行动和状态，不用性格标签替代证据。

explanation.transfer: She is shy but sent her idea in a message，能说她没有表达想法吗？指出行动证据。
